proposal.thesis: The 2026-08-28 weekly review made the kill explicit: stamp a $200 stop / $238 target / $220-by-2026-09-18 time-box on this seat, or close it. Today's regular session is that first session, and the 2026-08-31 daily bar closed $199.09 (price_as_of 2026-08-31, universe_scan/position_histories) — through the only stop that was ever written. original_plan is still null, there is no chandelier and no resting broker stop, and the fill itself was $213.16 against a written $211.50 ceiling. Two sessions have now broken the 20-day average (~$208 on the 6-month chart) and the 10-day high is 8.4% away. The 50-day (~$192) has not broken and the volume pane prints no_supply_pullback (rvol 0.71), so this is not a crash; it is an unprotected $70 seat that already spent the written stop. Invalidating_structure of the unattached plan has fired. Close it rather than invent a new $192 stop after $200 printed.
proposal.exit_reason: Written $200 stop from the 2026-08-28 weekly review; 2026-08-31 close $199.09 is through that level on a seat that never received original_plan or a resting stop.
